component.name: Readout
component.summary: Live readings, graphs and logs from a Bluetooth multimeter

description.p: Readout is a companion app for the EEVblog 121GW multimeter over Bluetooth LE. It shows the meter's display, graphs readings over time, logs and exports them as CSV, and presses the meter's buttons remotely.
The Linux build is a preview on the GTK4 backend for .NET MAUI. It needs BlueZ and a Bluetooth LE adapter; the demo meter works without either.
